title: Why Sub-4-Bit Vision CNNs Collapse and Where Mixed-Precision Recovery Stops
abstract: arXiv:2611.23445v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep vision models operating in resource-constrained environments depend heavily on low-bit quantization, yet compressing weights below 4 bits frequently induces catastrophic accuracy collapse. While mixed-precision recovery strategies aim to rescue accuracy by selectively retaining high-precision parameters, the fundamental mechanics of where and why these models collapse remain poorly understood. In this study, we systematically analyze the anatomy of quantization collapse across standard Vision CNNs (including ResNet and EfficientNet backbones) evaluated on the full 50,000-image ImageNet-1k validation set. First, we map the exact progression of degradation, demonstrating that collapse is highly non-linear and concentrated in late-stage pointwise projections and depthwise layers. Second, we introduce a structured, multi-step recovery waterfall that evaluates selective integer precision (INT4/INT8) and selective floating-point scales. W

translated_title: 为什么亚4比特视觉CNN会崩溃以及混合精度恢复的极限在哪里
translated_abstract: 在资源受限环境中运行的深度视觉模型严重依赖低比特量化，然而将权重压缩到4比特以下往往会引发灾难性的精度崩溃。尽管混合精度恢复策略旨在通过选择性地保留高精度参数来挽救精度，但这些模型在哪里以及为何崩溃的基本机制仍鲜为人知。在本研究中，我们基于完整的50,000张图像的ImageNet-1k验证集，系统分析了标准视觉CNN（包括ResNet和EfficientNet骨干网络）量化崩溃的机理。首先，我们绘制了性能退化的确切进程，证明崩溃是高度非线性的，并集中于后期的逐点投影层和深度可分离层。其次，我们引入了一个结构化的多步骤恢复瀑布方法，评估选择性整数精度（INT4/INT8）和选择性浮点缩放的应用效果。
tldr: 本研究系统剖析了视觉CNN在4比特以下量化时崩溃的机理，发现崩溃高度非线性且集中在后期逐点投影和深度可分离层，并提出了结构化的多步骤混合精度恢复瀑布策略来挽救精度。
en_tdlr: This study systematically dissects why sub-4-bit vision CNNs collapse—showing degradation is highly non-linear and concentrated in late-stage pointwise projections and depthwise layers—and introduces a structured multi-step mixed-precision recovery waterfall to restore accuracy.
